effects.printed_clause: During the Main Phase, if this card is in your hand (Quick Effect): Place it face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Trap.
effects.lua_implementation: A hand Main Phase Quick Effect moves the handler face-up to an open Spell & Trap Zone and applies TYPE_TRAP+TYPE_CONTINUOUS.

effects.printed_clause: While treated as a Continuous Trap: Place 1 Gravinity monster from your Deck, except Gravinity Plasma, face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Trap.
effects.lua_implementation: A free-chain Quick Effect in the Spell & Trap Zone requires current Trap type/free zone, selects a non-self Gravinity monster from Deck, moves it face-up and trapifies it.

official_references.matched_structure: Places an archetype monster from Deck as a face-up Continuous Trap.
Monster type conversion to Continuous Trap.

effects.printed_clause: While treated as a Continuous Trap: Move this card to another column.
effects.lua_implementation: A separate Quick Effect chooses an empty own Spell & Trap Zone and moves the handler by sequence.

official_references.matched_structure: Moves a card to another legal column/zone.

effects.printed_clause: You can only use each effect of Gravinity Plasma once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The three effects use id/id+100/id+200 hard once-per-turn keys.

effects.printed_clause: Support implementation for using this card as Gravinity Synchro material from the Spell & Trap Zone.
effects.lua_implementation: The extra Synchro material helper now returns true only for destination code Gravinity Lapsix or Gravinity Galaxix.

official_references.matched_structure: Official extra Synchro material effect with destination filter.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: Nebulix and Spherix print no Spell & Trap Zone material permission.

coverage_override.reason: Five records cover hand placement, Deck placement choice, column movement choice, per-effect HOPT, and destination-scoped extra-material support.
